```{ojs}
S0 = FileAttachment("../data/states.csv").csv({typed: true})
SY = FileAttachment("../data/state_year.csv").csv({typed: true})
SSY = FileAttachment("../data/state_sector_year.csv").csv({typed: true})
SI = FileAttachment("../data/state_items.csv").csv({typed: true})
POL = FileAttachment("../data/policy_grid.csv").csv({typed: true})
DE = FileAttachment("../data/de_state.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
S = S0.map(r => {
  const y = st => SY.filter(d => d.stabbr === r.st);
  const sy = SY.filter(d => d.stabbr === r.st), at = yr => sy.find(d => d.year === yr) ?? {};
  const ap = SI.find(d => d.stabbr === r.st && d.item === "AP credit") ?? {};
  const de = DE.find(d => d.stabbr === r.st) ?? {};
  const k = r.K;
  return {...r,
    T22_adj: 120 / r.ERadj_central_2022, T10_adj: 120 / r.ERadj_central_2010,
    res_cr: r.residual / k, items_cr: r.items_sum / k,
    tuition_deg_2024: at(2024).sticker_cost_per_degree_central, tuition_deg_2010: at(2010).sticker_cost_per_degree_central,
    tuition_deg_chg: at(2024).sticker_cost_per_degree_central / at(2010).sticker_cost_per_degree_central - 1,
    tuition_credit_chg: at(2024).sticker_price / at(2010).sticker_price - 1,
    ap_pb_2022: ap.per_ba_2022, de_per100_2022: de.de_credits_per_100_taught_2022,
    within_cc_sh: r.within_cc / r.dER_adj, within_pub_sh: r.within_pub / r.dER_adj};
})
MEAS = [
  {k: "ERadj_central_2022", l: "Timing-adjusted ER, 2022", f: f2},
  {k: "ER_2022", l: "Measured ER, 2022", f: f2},
  {k: "T22_adj", l: "Credits taught per degree (T), adjusted, 2022", f: f0, rev: true},
  {k: "dER_adj", l: "Rise in the adjusted ER, 2010–22", f: f3},
  {k: "dER", l: "Rise in the measured ER, 2010–22", f: f3},
  {k: "timing_central", l: "Timing removed from the rise (ER points)", f: f3, div: true},
  {k: "residual", l: "Efficiency gain: unexplained residual (ER points)", f: f3, div: true},
  {k: "res_cr", l: "Efficiency gain: fewer excess credits per degree", f: f0, div: true},
  {k: "share_residual", l: "Residual share of the adjusted rise", f: pct, div: true},
  {k: "items_cr", l: "Measured channels: credits per degree", f: f0, div: true},
  {k: "cc_share_CT_2022", l: "Community-college share of public credits, 2022", f: pct},
  {k: "within_cc", l: "Gain within community colleges (ER points)", f: f3, div: true},
  {k: "within_pub", l: "Gain within public universities (ER points)", f: f3, div: true},
  {k: "composition", l: "Degree-mix term (ER points)", f: f3, div: true},
  {k: "ap_pb_2022", l: "AP credit per degree, 2022", f: f2},
  {k: "de_per100_2022", l: "Dual-enrollment credit per 100 credits taught, 2022", f: f2},
  {k: "tuition_deg_2024", l: "Tuition per degree, 2024 (real $, adjusted ER)", f: usd},
  {k: "tuition_deg_chg", l: "Change in tuition per degree, 2010–24 (real)", f: pct, div: true},
  {k: "tuition_credit_chg", l: "Change in tuition per credit, 2010–24 (real)", f: pct, div: true}
]
MBY = new Map(MEAS.map(m => [m.k, m]))
colorFor = (m, vals) => {
  const ext = d3.extent(vals);
  if (m.div) { const a = d3.max(vals, Math.abs); return {type: "diverging", domain: [-a, a], scheme: "rdbu", pivot: 0}; }
  return {type: "linear", domain: ext, scheme: m.rev ? "oranges" : "blues"};
}
```

```{ojs}
md`<div class="ce-lead">Every state's public system produced more degree credit per credit taught in 2022 than in 2010. The measured channels do not predict which states gained most; the share of a state's credits taught at community colleges does, because most of the system gain happened inside community colleges. Pick a measure for the map, click a state for its profile, or switch to the scatter to compare any two measures.</div>`
```

```{ojs}
viewof mapm = Inputs.select(MEAS.map(m => m.k), {format: k => MBY.get(k).l, value: param("mapm", "res_cr"), label: "Map measure"})
viewof st = Inputs.select(STLIST, {format: s => STNAME[s], value: param("s", "CA"), label: "State"})
viewof mode = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Map", "map"], ["Scatter", "scatter"], ["Table", "table"]]), {value: param("view", "map"), label: "View"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("mapm", mapm); setParam("s", st); setParam("view", mode);
  const m = MBY.get(mapm);
  if (mode === "map") {
    const data = S.map(r => ({st: r.st, v: r[mapm]}));
    const sc = Plot.scale({color: colorFor(m, data.map(d => d.v).filter(isFinite))});
    const pick = s => { const el = viewof st; el.value = s; el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true})); };
    return html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start">
      ${tileMap(data, {color: v => sc.apply(v), fmt: m.f, selected: st, onPick: pick, w: Math.min(width, 700)})}
      <div style="max-width:300px">${Plot.legend({color: colorFor(m, data.map(d => d.v).filter(isFinite)), label: m.l, width: 280, tickFormat: m.f === pct ? "%" : null})}
      <p class="ce-note">Click a state to open its profile below. Grey: no value (Alaska and DC have no community-college sector).</p></div></div>`;
  }
  return html``;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof sx = mode === "scatter" ? Inputs.select(MEAS.map(m => m.k), {format: k => MBY.get(k).l, value: param("x", "cc_share_CT_2022"), label: "Horizontal"}) : html``
viewof sy = mode === "scatter" ? Inputs.select(MEAS.map(m => m.k), {format: k => MBY.get(k).l, value: param("y", "dER_adj"), label: "Vertical"}) : html``
viewof wfit = mode === "scatter" ? Inputs.radio(new Map([["Credit-weighted", true], ["Unweighted", false]]), {value: true, label: "Fit line"}) : html``
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (mode === "scatter") {
    setParam("x", sx); setParam("y", sy);
    const mx = MBY.get(sx), my = MBY.get(sy);
    const pts = S.filter(d => isFinite(d[sx]) && isFinite(d[sy]));
    const fit = wls(pts, d => d[sx], d => d[sy], d => wfit ? d.CT_2022 : 1);
    const xs = d3.extent(pts, d => d[sx]);
    return html`${Plot.plot({
      width, height: 520, grid: true,
      x: {label: mx.l, tickFormat: mx.f === pct ? "%" : null}, y: {label: my.l, tickFormat: my.f === pct ? "%" : null},
      r: {range: [3, 26]},
      marks: [
        Plot.line(xs.map(x => ({x, y: fit.a + fit.b * x})), {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: ORANGE, strokeDasharray: "5,4"}),
        Plot.dot(pts, {x: sx, y: sy, r: "CT_2022", fill: d => d.st === st ? ORANGE : BLUE, fillOpacity: 0.55, stroke: "white"}),
        Plot.text(pts, {x: sx, y: sy, text: "st", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
        Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: sx, y: sy, title: d => `${d.name}\n${mx.l}: ${mx.f(d[sx])}\n${my.l}: ${my.f(d[sy])}`}))
      ]
    })}<p class="ce-note">Dot size: credits taught in 2022. ${wfit ? "Credit-weighted" : "Unweighted"} least-squares line: slope ${d3.format(".3g")(fit.b)}, R² ${f2(fit.r2)}. Descriptive only: no standard errors here; the paper's tests (Section 8.2) report them.</p>`;
  }
  if (mode === "table") {
    return Inputs.table(S, {columns: ["name", "ERadj_central_2010", "ERadj_central_2022", "dER", "timing_central", "dER_adj", "items_sum", "residual", "res_cr", "share_residual", "cc_share_CT_2022", "within_cc", "within_pub", "composition"],
      header: {name: "State", ERadj_central_2010: "Adj. ER 2010", ERadj_central_2022: "Adj. ER 2022", dER: "Measured rise", timing_central: "Timing", dER_adj: "Adjusted rise", items_sum: "Items", residual: "Residual", res_cr: "Residual, credits/degree", share_residual: "Residual share", cc_share_CT_2022: "CC share 2022", within_cc: "Within CC", within_pub: "Within univ.", composition: "Mix"},
      format: {ERadj_central_2010: f3, ERadj_central_2022: f3, dER: f3, timing_central: f3, dER_adj: f3, items_sum: f3, residual: f3, res_cr: f0, share_residual: pct, cc_share_CT_2022: pct, within_cc: f3, within_pub: f3, composition: f3},
      sort: "residual", reverse: true, rows: 25});
  }
  return html``;
}
```

<div class="ce-kpi"><div class="v">${f0(R.T10_adj)} → ${f0(R.T22_adj)}</div><div class="l">credits taught per degree, adjusted</div></div>

  return Plot.plot({

    x: {...yearAxis, domain: [1998, 2024]}, y: {label: `${mlab} (${tlab})`, grid: true},

    marks: [
      showPol ? Plot.ruleX(pol, {x: "year", stroke: ORANGE, strokeOpacity: 0.6, strokeDasharray: "3,3"}) : null,
      ...(showPol ? d3.range(6).map(k => Plot.text(pol.filter(d => d.i % 6 === k), {x: "year", text: d => `${d.lab}${d.status === "Partial" ? " (partial)" : ""}`, frameAnchor: "top", dy: -12 * (Math.min(pol.length, 6) - k) + 4, fill: ORANGE, fontSize: 10, textAnchor: "start", dx: 3})) : []),
      timing !== "measured" ? Plot.lineY(pts, {x: "year", y: "vm", stroke: "who", strokeDasharray: "2,3", strokeOpacity: 0.5}) : null,
      Plot.lineY(pts, {x: "year", y: "v", stroke: "who", strokeWidth: 2.3}),
      Plot.text(pts, Plot.selectLast({x: "year", y: "v", z: "who", text: d => `${d.who} ${fv(d.v)}`, fill: "who", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start"})),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointerX({x: "year", y: "v", title: d => `${d.who}, ${d.year}\n${fv(d.v)} (${tlab})\nmeasured ${fv(d.vm)}`}))
    ]
  });
}

```{ojs}
{
  const lab = {"c_AP_credit": "AP credit", "c_Fewer_leavers": "Fewer leavers", "c_Unreported_DE_credit": "Unreported dual-enrollment credit", "c_Reported_DE_credit_never_used": "Reported DE credit never used", "c_Less_non-degree_credit": "Less unused non-degree credit", "c_AA_counted_twice": "Associate degrees counted twice", "c_Certificate_credit": "Certificate credit", "c_Net_interstate_credit_inflow": "Net interstate credit"};
  const rows = [{l: "Timing removed", v: R.timing_central / R.K, kind: "t"}, ...Object.entries(lab).map(([k, l]) => ({l, v: R[k] / R.K, kind: "i"})), {l: "Residual: fewer excess credits", v: R.residual / R.K, kind: "r"}];
  return Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 900), height: 40 + 28 * rows.length, marginLeft: 240, marginRight: 60,
    x: {label: "Fewer credits per bachelor's-degree equivalent, 2010 → 2022", grid: true}, y: {label: null, domain: rows.map(d => d.l)},
    marks: [Plot.ruleX([0]),
      Plot.barX(rows, {y: "l", x: "v", fill: d => d.kind === "r" ? ORANGE : d.kind === "t" ? GRAY : BLUE}),
      Plot.text(rows, {y: "l", x: d => Math.max(0, d.v), text: d => d3.format("+.1f")(d.v), dx: 5, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11})]
  });
}
```

::: {.ce-note}
Contributions are converted from ER points to credits with the state's own `ER₀·ER₁/120`. Timing is removed before the items; items plus the residual equal the timing-adjusted rise. AP credit is allocated by the state where scores were sent; dual enrollment by the providing college's state; the interstate item moves credit carried by students who cross state lines (an assumption: IPEDS reports transfer students by state of residence only in 1986 and 1988).
:::

```{ojs}
{
  const pts = SY.filter(d => d.stabbr === st && d.sticker_cost_per_degree_measured > 0).flatMap(d => [
    {year: d.year, v: d.sticker_cost_per_degree_measured, s: "Per degree, measured ER"},
    {year: d.year, v: d.sticker_cost_per_degree_central, s: "Per degree, adjusted ER"},
    {year: d.year, v: d.sticker_price * 4, s: "Four years of full-time tuition"}]);
  return Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 900), height: 300, marginLeft: 65, marginRight: 200, title: `Published in-state tuition per degree, ${STNAME[st]} public system (real 2024 $)`,
    x: {...yearAxis}, y: {label: "Real 2024 dollars", grid: true, tickFormat: "$,.0f"},
    color: {domain: ["Four years of full-time tuition", "Per degree, measured ER", "Per degree, adjusted ER"], range: [GRAY, LIGHT, BLUE]},
    marks: [Plot.lineY(pts, {x: "year", y: "v", stroke: "s", strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.text(pts, Plot.selectLast({x: "year", y: "v", z: "s", text: d => `${d.s} ${usd(d.v)}`, fill: "s", dx: 5, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10})),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointerX({x: "year", y: "v", z: "s", title: d => `${d.s} ${d.year}: ${usd(d.v)}`}))]
  });
}
```

::: {.ce-note}
Tuition per degree = tuition per credit × 120 / ER: what students pay for the credits a system teaches per degree it awards. Four years of full-time tuition is the same price with ER = 1. Credit-hour weighted over public institutions reporting published tuition. Sources: IPEDS; author's calculations, white paper v5 Sections 5 and 8.2–8.3.
:::
